name: time-picker
title: Time Picker
description: A time field made of an hour and a minute that are each stepped with the arrow keys or typed, with an AM/PM part where the locale uses a 12-hour clock. The value is a 24-hour "HH:mm" string.

meta.when: Any time of the person's own choosing: an opening hour, a reminder, an arrival. When the times on offer are a fixed list use slot-picker. Never the browser's native time input. Name it with `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby`.
